mutations.name: a round open exactly six hours is nudged
kills: the round age nudge does not nudge a round open exactly 6 h, and nudges it a millisecond later

mutations.name: a withdrawn round is nudged
kills: the round age nudge never nudges a withdrawn round, in the inbox or the digest

mutations.name: the rec answer writes feedback.json itself, bypassing rounds.submit
mutations.find: const result = await submit({ id, manifestSha256, answers: built.answers, general: ANSWERED_BY_REC });
mutations.replace: const result = await import("./state-file.js").then(({ writeJsonOnce }) => writeJsonOnce(path.join(roundDir, "feedback.json"), { general: ANSWERED_BY_REC, answers: built.answers })).then(() => ({ status: "submitted" as const, path: roundDir, sha256: manifestSha256, headSha: null }));
kills: rounds.answer-rec answers every question with its recommendation through rounds.submit, marked answered-by-rec

mutations.name: an after-answer round's nudge prints its recommendations
kills: the round age nudge states no recommendation for an after-answer round, in the inbox or the digest, yet its one tap still answers through rounds.submit
